answer: Anchor each identity to a one-time charitable gift: donate Rp2,000,000 to the registered Comet Haven charity at its annual Comet Appeal, funding one named tree in its grove, with a receipt signed by its treasurer. Two verifiers check the receipt and planting record against the charity register within a week, and a duplicate receipt voids both. One gift is modest for an honest holder, but 1,000 fake identities would have to donate Rp2,000,000,000.
